title: What Would Dragons Actually Change?
lesson: A monster changes a world through what ordinary people must do differently: what they roof with, where they keep their animals, where they build, how they travel, and who holds power once someone has to watch the sky.

voice.direction: The same curious lab host as EP26: brisk, warm, a little playful. The hook is a confident claim. The week count is quick and flat. 'Nobody fought a war' lands low; 'just stopped working' is a shrug. The four changes are crisp list beats. 'Someone has to watch the sky' is a quiet aha; 'Rule five is power' is sure. The comment ask is genuinely curious.

lines.text: If dragons existed, your world's architecture would look very different.
Let's test it. This village was built before the dragon came.
Week one: thatch burns. Week two: open pens, empty. Week three: no one travels.
Nobody fought a war. The village just stopped working.
So rebuild it. Four changes are easy. The fifth is the twist.
One: roofs. Slate and turf don't burn.
Two: pens. Flocks sleep in covered barns.
Three: place. Move into the valley, out of sight.
Four: travel. Trade moves at night, under the trees.
Now the roofs hold, the flocks grow, and trade returns.
Rule five? Someone has to watch the sky.
A tower rises, with a bell. Whoever rings it decides when everyone hides.
Rule five is power. The dragon changed who's in charge.
Don't just add a dragon. Ask what ordinary people do differently.
What would your civilization invent to survive dragons? Comment below.
Part 27 of 50. Follow for part 28: something on the Isle learns to build.

shots.purpose: Pay off EP26's open loop and stop the scroll: the dragon has landed on the Isle.
shots.visual: The dragon perched on the Grimmaw's meadow in golden light, wings raised; the Grimmaw looks up at it; the open thatched village behind. It rears on 'dragons' (dust ring). WORLD ENGINE boots top-right.
shots.camera: Long lens (fov 17 from dist 66, el 9, az 14), slow drift and push; the last 10 s return to this exact pose.
shots.lighting: Golden hour (low sun from the east, long shadows).
shots.onScreenText: IF DRAGONS / EXISTED then YOUR WORLD / WOULD LOOK / DIFFERENT.
shots.music: Hook: the series theme on celesta over strings; a hit on 'different'.

shots.purpose: Meet the subject (the dragon) and the naive village it lands on, then press RUN.
shots.visual: Field card intro (DRAGON sprite x3, FLYING APEX, HUNTS anything in the open) over the village: thatch roofs, open pens, the hall at the top of the slope, the trade road. The sim bar slides in with ROOFS / FLOCK / TRADE; RUN is pressed and the dragon takes off.
shots.camera: Medium on the village (dist 62), then rise to the wide on 'run'.
shots.transition: Ripple + rise to the wide on 'run'.
shots.music: Pulse: pizzicato eighths, the theme's answer on celesta.

shots.purpose: The naive village runs and fails, in numbers.
shots.visual: The whole Isle; the dragon circles the open village; thatch roofs char one by one and smoke; FLOCK 60→9; carts leave the road; WEEK 0→3; ROOFS 07→00.
shots.onScreenText: WEEK 01..03; graph WEEKS 0–3; TRADE ROAD: EMPTY.
shots.music: Drive: 16th marimba, square-lead arps, pizzicato, bass, drums; a burn crackle bed.

shots.purpose: The punchline of the failure: no battle, the way of life just stops working.
shots.visual: Close on the burnt, empty village in gloom; the dragon glides home to its lair under the peak. COLLAPSED stamp; IT JUST STOPPED.
shots.onScreenText: COLLAPSED · NO WAR · WEEK 3; IT JUST STOPPED.
shots.music: Drop: near silence, a taiko boom on 'stopped'.

shots.purpose: Re-hook: rewind and open a loop (four easy changes, one locked twist).
shots.visual: REWIND chip and scanlines; roofs un-char, sheep and carts return; the DRAGON-PROOF checklist with a blinking locked row 5.
shots.music: Mystery: celesta arpeggios and harp; a riser into 'the twist'.

rows.label: PLACE
rows.text: in a valley, out of sight

shots.visual: Close on the houses; thatch roofs flip to slate and turf one by one; pin THATCH → SLATE / WON'T CATCH; row 1 ticks.
shots.onScreenText: 1 ROOFS · slate and turf, not thatch

shots.visual: Close on the open pen; a covered barn rises beside it; pin FLOCKS / UNDER COVER; row 2 ticks.

shots.purpose: Change 3: settle out of the sky's sight lines.
shots.visual: Near top-down; a rust ring marks the open site (SEEN FROM THE SKY); each building unbuilds and rises again in the valley under the cliff, the flock follows; an ember ring and OUT OF SIGHT.
shots.onScreenText: 3 PLACE · in a valley, out of sight

shots.purpose: Change 4: travel at night, under the trees.
shots.visual: Night; the road moves into the forest; carts with lit lanterns roll under the canopy; pin NIGHT ROAD / UNDER THE TREES.
shots.onScreenText: 4 TRAVEL · by night, under the trees

shots.purpose: The dragon-proof village runs: it holds.
shots.visual: Wide Isle; the dragon circles the valley and finds nothing in the open; roofs stay 07, FLOCK 60→92, TRADE 6→9; THRIVING stamp.
shots.onScreenText: WEEKS 0–12; HUNTING: NOTHING IN THE OPEN; THRIVING · NO ROOF LOST
shots.music: Drive with the theme on flute and glockenspiel; a stab and cymbal on 'grow'.

shots.purpose: The locked rule: someone has to watch the sky.
shots.visual: RULE 5?, then a stone watchtower rises on the cliff with a bell; its watch ring covers the valley; the dragon passes, the bell swings, the carts vanish (everyone hides); pin THE BELL-RINGER / DECIDES WHEN WE HIDE.
shots.onScreenText: RULE 5?; THE BELL-RINGER · DECIDES WHEN WE HIDE
shots.music: A held A7♭9 and a timpani roll, the tower bell on 'bell' and 'rings', a hard stop on 'hides'.

shots.visual: Row 5 unlocks (POWER · whoever rings the bell); close on the tower and bell; NEW POWER / THE TOWER; trade comes back; the island ripples on 'charge'.
shots.music: Swell into a big D-major hit on 'charge'.

shots.purpose: The takeaway: the full design check, screenshot-able.
shots.visual: The complete DRAGON-PROOF card (BEFORE YOU ADD A DRAGON, 5 rows ticked) with 'Ask what ordinary people change.' in serif italic.
shots.transition: Block wipe to the end card.
shots.music: Anthem: the theme in D major on flute, horns and glockenspiel; the World Engine chime as the card lands.

rows.label: PLACE
rows.text: in a valley, out of sight

shots.visual: End card: logo, PART 27 / 50, title, a speech-bubble COMMENT panel: What would your civilization invent to survive dragons?
shots.camera: Cut (under the block wipe) to the hook pose.
shots.music: Outro: the theme's answer on celesta and music box.

shots.purpose: Say the part number, ask for the follow with a specific reason (part 28), and open the next loop: stones stack themselves on the lake shore.
shots.visual: The end card lifts onto the hook frame; PART 27/50 season bar; FOLLOW FOR PART 28 pressed on 'Follow'; NEXT RUN 28 · BUILDERS decodes from a locked cairn; on the shore a cairn's three stones stack themselves; then the hook title returns for the loop.
shots.camera: The hook pose (long lens), drifting onto frame 0.

layers.foreground: progress bar, follow button, next-run card

shots.onScreenText: PART 27/50 · FOLLOW FOR PART 28 · NEXT RUN: BUILDERS · SOMETHING LEARNS TO BUILD.
shots.music: Tease: the theme's opening as a question over a held A, a horn call, the engine chime on 'Follow'; it resolves into frame 0's D minor on the loop.
